How do tracing, evaluations, and Signals fit together?

smart_toy

Partial answer — points supported by the documentation:

Weave tracing is built on Ops, Calls, Traces, and Threads [S3]. [S3]
An Evaluation object defines a dataset or list of test examples and one or more scoring functions. [S2]
Signals surface quality and safety issues and highlight the traces that need attention [S1]. [S1]
Signals is one tab next to tabs for conversations and spans [S7]. [S7]
